reviews.comment: This was the first time this class was offered, and I think she did really good. The labs were always fun and she was always there to answer questions during them. She was very understanding about missing a lab for ring day and she held a make up session.

Dr. Anderson is fantastic. I took her Fossil Evidence class in Fall 2025, and absolutely loved it. Her lectures are awesome, and you can tell she is extremely passionate about her work. Hands down, one of my favorite professors in the department.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: If you're looking for an online class, 100% take her class. Her lecture slides are extremely easy to understand, and she's also really accessible outside of class. The classwork is pretty easy, and the tests are also easy if you study beforehand.
Easy online elective. Quiz per week with a short assignment to make sure you looked over lectures. Exams are straight from powerpoints and quizzes.
Super straightforward class with easily accessible material for the quizzes/exams. Great option for a general elective and easy A. Would take her again

HIGHLY recommend. Easy A. 2 online videos a week with a quiz/ lecture check and 3 exams ALL open note. Very kind professor and good teacher. Lectures are interesting but you don't even need to watch to pass. If you're looking for an easy class for credit take her!

I took ANTH 205 with Anderson and loved it! There were weekly lecture check ins and quizzes. There were only 3 exams all open note. Her lectures were actually very interesting as well. However, questions are straight from her lectures so even if it is online, you still need to watch the weekly lectures in order to be able to answer the questions.

She is probably one of the most insincere people in the department. Most of the Anth professors do not care unless you're one of their “pets” but she is remarkably unfriendly outside of class vs in class she's very enthusiastic. It takes zero effort to say hello outside of class yet she just gives a dirty look. Glad I am out of her class.

Dr. Anderson is an awesome professor. I had her for four of my undergrad ANTH classes. She is very passionate about what she teaches, and her lectures are very interesting (ask her about her fieldwork &  research). She is a very caring, kind, and approachable professor. She gives clear feedback, grades fairly, and gives extra credit.
100% RECOMMEND

Very personable and willing to re-explain anything. She makes it very obvious what will be on quizzes and exams. Can be a lot of info sometimes but she provides many resources. Held extra office hours when asked. Very knowledgeable. Material was interesting and engaging.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I don't know why people don't like her! She's quirky for sure but she loves anthropology and it shows. She is also very into monkeys because I think that is what she studies. She is very kind and very friendly if you visit her during office hours. Definitely would take a course again with her if I had the chance.

if you need an anthropology credit i highly recommend her, because its very easy. but oh my GOD she drove me INSANE. i know its just a me problem, but this lady is obsessed with "non-human primates" and managed to relate it to EVERY LECTURE. i thought i was safe for the halloween lecture and then she showed up in a monkey costume

Prof. Anderson is an amazing human! Very passionate and knowledgeable about anthropology. STUDY BOLDED terms and statements from her slides (of specified lectures for exams) and the practice exams as well as the quizzes before each exam and you will ace them. Go to class. Unfortunately I had some mental health issues up until the last exam, so a C-
Professor Anderson is super cool. She clearly cares about what she teaches and her exams are online and at home. Just show up to lectures and you'll be fine!

Quizzes and exams were all online & open note. I highly recommend going to the lectures and taking notes on the material, as sometimes a test/extra credit question will be something that she only mentioned in class. There was a textbook for this class; I got it, never used it, & did just fine (if you want to read a textbook, there is a free one).

Does not curve unfortunately, so close to an A. She's really sweet and accessible out of class. Enjoyed her lectures. Open note online quizzes. Tests were hard and memorization heavy. Extra credit opportunity that was fun. Probably my favorite professor so far. Definitely take her if you can.

This class was not my style at all. We would go through 20-25 slides a day with little to no discussion from students. Quizzes every week about the lecture material. Tests are super detailed and over hundreds of specific details of what we learned. She is super nice, but didn't really help when I asked questions after class.

I can't believe some of the reviews on here. Dr. Anderson was a phenomenal professor. She was great at articulating what would be on the test and quizzes. She has genuine interest in what she teaches and it shows in her presentations. Some of the material she presented was so interesting that I found myself researching about it outside of class.

Not as great as reviews make the class seem. It is not a blow-off AT ALL. I pulled an all nighter for each exam because of how hard they were, and only received an A on the last one. You have to memorize every little detail of the content, to where even if you know the content really well you will still fail. Other assignments were easy A's.

As long as you're willing to put in the effort and study time, don't let this class intimidate you. Quizzes are online open notes, guest lectures are completion grades. Lecture slides are posted- STILL GO TO CLASS! Dr Anderson is amazing & also very available during office hours to discuss class material, anthropology career advice, grad school,etc
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures were interesting enough but the tests were much harder than I expected, and seemed to get progressively harder. I had to memorize about every single family name of monkeys in order to get a B. When you are studying, you have to know every single detail she mentions in the lectures, no matter how minute they may seem.

Dr. Anderson is an awesome professor and very cool person. I would absolutely love to take any course that she teaches However, her course is more difficult than other anthropology courses that I've taken, but it definitely isn't unreasonable. Just don't expect it to be a blow off class.
I took this class during Covid and I got a great grade in the class and it was super easy!

Dr. Anderson is NOT the difficult part of this course. It's fast-paced and a lot of material. Attendance isn't mandatory GO ANYWAY. Tests are tough and not returned. Take advantage of office hours to discuss mistakes. Quizzes are consistent and short, but you don't know when, so just do your reading. Her lectures aren't boring because it's her jam.

I had to take this class for my degree, and wasn't expecting it to be as interesting as it was. There are small quizzes every once in a while, but they're usually pretty open ended. The tests aren't bad as long as you are paying attention. I also had to miss a few days of class, but Dr. Anderson was very accommodating.

She was quiet at first as she was readjusting to in-person learning, but she opened up later and started joking more. She also had really good lectures, and used her personal XP to give it more life. She is also great at helping students who are considering grad school!

Professor Anderson has been a great educator this past semester and is always very helpful! You can tell she truly enjoys her field of study, and this makes her lectures even more interesting. The course work is very manageable and the tests are just challenging enough. I would recommend her to anyone interested in taking an anth class!

The course has a lot of material to cover (and I mean a LOT), so it's not exactly her fault she has to speed through some of it. She's very clear about what will be tested on though so it doesn't cause many difficulties. Very caring and passionate about anthropology and primates, and wants you to learn about the actual work outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Anderson gets a bad rep. She's a great professor and her lectures are super interesting. I can tell she actually cares about her students, and she takes time to answer questions and go into depth about topics. I took ANTH312 with her and it was my favorite class I have taken at TAMU. I never felt overwhelmed and I think she is an amazing prof!

The course is challenging, and you're going to have to work for a high grade. There were only a few pop quizzes, but just be prepared before going into class because they were difficult. However, Professor Anderson was enthusiastic about the subject, and I did enjoy going to her class. She is very kind and communicated well with her students!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Anderson is really sweet and very knowledgable. You will learn a TON in this class. However, the pop quizzes are only a few questions and are really hard. Exams are difficult, but if you study you will be fine and she gives an extra credit assignment. This class is not an easy A but its very interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She covers a lot of information fairly quickly, but posts every lecture and useful resource online. She is easy to access and communicates well with students. The pop quizzes are unpredictable, but the class overall is manageable. I found the class to be interesting and informative, but I wouldn't suggest taking it if you are looking for an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She goes way too fast in the lectures. The study guides do NOT help and most of what is on there is not on the exam. She talks about herself way too much. Exams and pop quizzes are the only grades in the class. I would just take the class online if I were you.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy
